description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest' for the LeaveEntitlementDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the 'getLeaveBalance' method under various scenarios, including with and without unlinked leave periods, multiple entitlements, and date range filters. The test setup involves mocking related services and strategies to verify the leave balance calculations in different conditions.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDaoGetLeaveBalanceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlementDao in the OrangeHRM system, testing various scenarios for leave balance calculation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by instantiating the DAO and loading test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalance
methods.description: Executes multiple assertions to verify the correctness of leave balance calculations across various date ranges and entitlement conditions.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests the leave balance calculation with specific unlinked leave date limits, verifying the inclusion of linked and unlinked leave balances.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeaveWhenAfterPeriod
methods.description: Verifies leave balance when the unlinked leave period is after the given date range, expecting exclusion of unlinked leave.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedBeforePeriod
methods.description: Tests the effect of unlinked leave periods that start before the date range, expecting proper exclusion.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceExcludingUnlinkedLeave
methods.description: Tests leave balance calculation when the unlinked leave date limits are null, expecting default calculation without unlinked leave considerations.
